keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Diego Sánchez (Tigres).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Tigres 0, Cruz Azul 1. Nicolás Ibáñez (Cruz Azul) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Andrés Montaño.
José Paradela (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card.
Érik Lira (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card.
Mauro Laínez (Tigres) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Tigres 1, Cruz Azul 1. Juan Brunetta (Tigres) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Fernando Gorriarán.
Substitution, Tigres. Joaquim replaces Rafael Guerrero.
Goal! Tigres 1, Cruz Azul 2. Andrés Montaño (Cruz Azul) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Delay in match because of an injury Gonzalo Piovi (Cruz Azul).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Carlos Rodríguez replaces Luka Romero.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Agustín Palavecino replaces Érik Lira.
Goal! Tigres 2, Cruz Azul 2. Guillermo Martínez (Tigres) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Tigres. Diego Lainez replaces Henrique Simeone.
Substitution, Tigres. Ricardo Monreal replaces Diego Sánchez.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Carlos Rotondi replaces Omar Campos.
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Willer Ditta replaces Jorge Rodarte.
Carlos Rotondi (Cruz Azul) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Vladimir Loroña (Tigres).
Substitution, Cruz Azul. Christian Ebere replaces Nicolás Ibáñez.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Tigres 2, Cruz Azul 3. Carlos Rotondi (Cruz Azul) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Jeremy Márquez with a cross.
Fernando Gorriarán (Tigres) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
